items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: What's your call, my mom? Woody Hoyman, Hawkins, Roy Irish, Oil Hines, Sarah Vones.

ctx.x: You've played a lot of brass band work.

You've played brass band, I played Tuxi the brass band with John, made the recording with John, made the recording with John, a couple of LPs we cut with John, brass band, cut some LPs with George Lewis' band. Also went to play the festival last year with all the big shots, Coleman Hawkins. Los Angeles. Yeah, we were in Monterey, California. Oh, up there. Yeah, that's right. Yes, sir. What's your call, my mom? Woody Hoyman, Hawkins, Roy Irish, Oil Hines, Sarah Vones.
Yeah, I remember we read about that. What's the lady's name, Homer?
